tha-ap239:1.1: samattaṃ. [237. Piyālapupphiya.] Migaluddo pure āsiṃ araññe kānane ahaṃ / piyālaṃ pupphitaṃ disvā gatamagge khipim ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap239:2.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap239:4.1: Itthaṃ sudam ayasmā Piyālapupphiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
